mathematics_and_model: All-other-columns fiber equals the actual partial reveal with empty exposed set. A random set determined by these columns is constant there.
Residual digit count is the intersection of its complement with the selected digit subset. Exact finite-population law has population n, marked full-column allowedCount, draws n-|A|.
Half-mean threshold retains the atom-specific random |A|. Replacing it by a representative value is justified only on that fiber.
The reserve A subset R gives residual mean at least g times full-column allowedCount; averaging all positive history atoms gives the unconditional tail.
adversarial: No independence of A from other columns or suffixes required. It must be determined by all columns except the tested one.
Zero marked count yields a valid bound of one; no division by a potentially zero residual population introduced.
Fine-history impossibility is handled by actual reveal APIs and averaging only positive fibers; no conclusion is conditioned on the final good event.
remaining_obligations: Actual unequal witness cylinders, failure union, variance and coarse endpoint atom transfer remain U03 tasks.
